answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. A river of per-task receipts records who did what, and the delta of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, revoked by a single upheld challenge. Reaching the mirror of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
